--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,27 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
+    # Input validation
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
+    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar")
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2-dimensional matrices")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must not be empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all() or (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite and nonpositive")
+
+    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+
+    margins = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1) - np.maximum(
+        np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1), np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    )
+    keep = margins > tau_filter
+    return keep, margins
